models.title: LIFO and FIFO in the same history
models.invariant: Same operation history and occupancy; LIFO and FIFO remove different identities.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Ring wrap with front and count
models.invariant: Logical rank j occupies (front+j) mod capacity; count distinguishes full and empty.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.invariant: Only logical-order copies are published; old physical order is not treated as FIFO order.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Why transferring early fails
models.invariant: Explicit counterexample: transfer into a nonempty output stack violates FIFO.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Exact operand order and arithmetic
models.invariant: Value stack represents completed subexpressions; pop right before left; use exact rational arithmetic.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Duplicate maximum restoration
models.invariant: Each auxiliary entry is the maximum of its data-stack prefix; duplicate maxima remain represented.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Cyclic rotations and Josephus removal
models.invariant: Rotate k-1 survivors modulo current length, then remove the kth identity.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Recursive restoration continuations
models.invariant: Distinct pending continuation values restore the original stack on return; call depth and total work differ.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: A stack built from FIFO rotations
models.invariant: Queue front is newest simulated stack item after each completed expensive push.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Noncommutative aggregate directions
models.invariant: Completed public queue fold is output top-to-bottom followed by input bottom-to-top; partial transfers are internal.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.invariant: An appended identity removes larger rear values; each created identity can be deleted at most once.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Algorithm teaching example: Stack size without representation access
models.invariant: A transfer reverses stack orientation; the restoration pass restores the source.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Exact problem trace: Why copying on the first pass reverses the copy
models.invariant: A transfer reverses stack orientation; the restoration pass restores the source.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.invariant: A transfer reverses stack orientation; the restoration pass restores the source.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Exact problem trace: Queue sum with restoration
models.invariant: Two FIFO transfers restore the queue; running sum covers exactly the values moved in the first pass.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.invariant: Output is a postfix prefix; operator stack obeys precedence and incoming associativity.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Exact problem trace: Duplicate maxima
models.invariant: Each auxiliary entry is the maximum of its data-stack prefix; duplicate maxima remain represented.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.title: Exact problem trace: Associative but noncommutative aggregate
models.invariant: Completed public queue fold is output top-to-bottom followed by input bottom-to-top; partial transfers are internal.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.invariant: Candidates are unresolved indices; each removed index receives its first qualifying position.
models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.

models.assumptions: Sequential bounded model; word-sized slots unless exact rational expression arithmetic is stated. Diagram scalar identities are stable where values are distinct; duplicated data use explicit positions/indices and do not imply ambiguous moving identities.
